author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.6.1. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched.

NO MORE DEVICE PICKER. Press Done and the scan starts. Every device is scanned, so the map no longer depends on remembering to tick them all.

FIX: apps beyond the fifth on any shared device were never discovered. Hid 12 of 74 apps on the test hub. Re-scan after installing.

NEW: rule-to-rule links. Shows when one rule runs, cancels, pauses or sets the Private Boolean of another. Filter: "Rule to rule only".

NEW: external systems. What each app needs outside the hub, drawn as diamonds. Known integrations are recognised automatically; your own entries override them and can be backed up to a file.

Focused view is now laid out by relationship: inputs left, outputs right, rules below, external systems above.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
